definition.note: Schoen's Complementary H surface: same pattern of straight lines and reflectional symmetries as the Schwarz H surface but with extra handles raising the genus per cell to 7; a 1-parameter family limiting in 3-fold dihedral Callahan-Hoffman-Meeks surfaces one way and a nodal configuration the other.
